newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Airways says Cameroon to fly UK passengers.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Airways says Cameroon to fly UK passengers.

text.p: Cameroon Airlines will from next week fly Nigeria Airways passengers to London to beat a mutual flight ban imposed by Nigeria and Britain on aircraft registered in both countries, the Nigerian airline said.

Nigeria Airways spokesman Chris Aligbe, who announced this on Monday night, said Cameroon Airlines would also lift Nigeria Airways passengers from London to Douala, from where the Nigerian airline will take the passengers to Lagos.
British Airways passengers in Nigeria have since the flight ban last month either changed their tickets to other carriers or had to travel to Accra, Ghana to connect with British Airways flights.
The British government had banned all Nigeria registered aircraft from British airspace, alleging poor safety records by the Nigerian carrier.
The Nigerian authorities in turn banned all British registered aircraft from Nigeria and negotiations to end the face-off have so far yielded no positive results.
